_purpose: Facts the repository cannot observe for itself. Every entry here is rendered on the dashboard with a MANUAL badge, the observer's name and the observation date. Nothing in this file is measured by tooling; it is testimony, and it is labelled as testimony.
_rules: state must be one of: manual, notVerified, disabled, notInstrumented, awaitingData.
state 'manual' REQUIRES value, observer and observed_at. The other states must NOT have a value.
Use 'notVerified' for a fact nobody has looked at yet. Never guess a value.
observed_at is a UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) or full ISO 8601 timestamp.
Manual entries older than the freshness window are automatically downgraded to 'Not verified' by the generator, keeping the original date in the note.
owner/observer is a name or role. Never put an email address, phone number or any other contact detail in this file.
